 Order

In this petition, petitioner is seeking grant of bail in Crime No.04/2023 of Vijaynagar Police Station,
Bengaluru City, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468 and 471 of IPC.
2.

Heard the arguments of Sri. K.N. Narayana Swamy learned counsel for the petitioner and Smt.
Sowmya.
R learned HCGP.
3. The brief facts of the case are, the petitioner is the owner cum driver of the Maruthi Swift Desire car bearing Reg.No.KA-02-AG-2852.
The said vehicle met with an accident and injured has filed a claim in MVC.No.416/2020 before the MACT, Bangalore.
The car is covered with insurance from 30.09.2019 23:55 to 29.09.2020 23:59:59.

But before the tribunal, the NC: 2023:KHC:37712 petitioner has tampered with the policy of insurance, making it believe that the car is covered with insurance from 29.09.2019 to 30.09.2020 and attempted to claim the insurance, by cheating the insurer which came to the knowledge of the insurer.
On the complaint law is set into motion against the petitioner.

4. It is the contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner that Ex.R.1 is the policy of insurance produced before the tribunal by the insurance company, which ratifies that on the date and time of the accident there is a valid insurance cover and there is no tampering with the policy of insurance.
The petitioner is a permanent resident of Bangalore.
He is ready to assist in the investigation, abide any conditions and he may be granted bail.

5. Per contra, learned HCGP has contended that the petitioner has tampered with the policy of insurance to make believe that the car had valid insurance coverage at NC: 2023:KHC:37712 the time and date of the accident.
When the claim notice was received by the insurance company, it came to their knowledge and hence, a complaint was filed.
As the petitioner has committed a white-collar crime, he is not entitled for discretionary bail.
6. I have given my anxious consideration to the arguments of both sides and perused the materials on record.
7. The specific allegation against the petitioner is that he has tampered with the date of insurance coverage for his car.
Whether the policy of insurance issued by the insurance company was for a period from 30.09.2019 to 29.09.2020, has the petitioner tampered it as 29.09.2019 to 30.09.2020.
It is a matter of investigation for which the petitioner has come forward to assist in the investigation.
Alleged offences are not punishable with death or imprisonment for life.
The petitioner is a permanent resident of Bangalore.
He has under taken to abide any NC: 2023:KHC:37712 conditions that would be imposed.

8. In the result, the following;
ORDER (i) The Petition is allowed.

(ii) The petitioner is ordered to be released on bail in the event of his arrest in Crime No.04/2023 of Vijaynagar Police, Bengaluru City, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468 and 471 of IPC, on execution of a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with one surety for the like-sum to the satisfaction of the concerned Investigating Officer.
